messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] region-us-west2 GPU pool 'gw-pool-3' reporting high eviction rate (20%) and request queue growth. Observed at 2026-05-18T12:01:08Z. Incident ID: INC-20260518-642
alex: seeing error 'nvlink timeout' in host logs, 6/30 hosts in pool flapping.
jae: confirmed, fabric link flaps between rack7-8, kernel OOM not likely. Evictions start ~12:00 UTC.
alex: starting controlled traffic reroute to us-central1 spare pool. Plan: shift 25% immediate, then 100% if stable. Command:
```
rictl shift-traffic --from=us-west2 --to=us-central1 --percent=25 --grace=30s --preserve-kv
```
maria: note: us-central1 has limited qps for deduped workloads, can also route burst to asia1-burst if needed (higher cost).
jae: +1 on staged shift. Add cache-warmup flag to avoid cold-start latencies.
alex: executing now. Will monitor latency and token-per-second. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: action log: traffic-shift started by alex at 1796102468. percent=25. target=us-central1.
sam: paging policy question — current pagerbot escalation window is 5m -> 10m during regional incidents? We should reduce to 3m to avoid missed handoffs.
jae: agree. For this event, set pagerbot escalation to (ack=3m, notify-secondary=7m). I'll update the incident-runbook.
alex: update applied. pagerbot config snippet:
```
pagerbot.set_policy('infra', ack_window=180, escalate_to='oncall-rotation', notify_leads_after=600)
```
maria: latency spike observed +120ms for streaming RPCs, but p50 stable. Token cost will increase if we keep asia1-burst; prefer us-central for now.
alex: traffic shift to 25% completed, no errors. Queue length down 8%.
jae: fabric team alerted, they're running link diagnostics and will attempt restart of ToR on affected racks in 10m.
infra-bot: note: runbook tag 'urgent-network' attached. Incident timeline URL: https://redwood.tools/incidents/INC-20260518-642
alex: prepping handoff to night oncall (maria). Summary: degraded gpu pool due to fabric flaps, staged reroute to us-central1, pagerbot ack window lowered to 3m, fabric team investigating. Will follow up in 20m or handoff.
maria: taking handoff. Please add runbook checklist entries and pointer to the fabric diag logs. I'll continue monitoring and coordinate with fabric team. :thumbsup:
alex: added checklist and diag link. Leaving channel, ping me if it escalates.
infra-bot: incident status: monitoring. last_update=1796102650.
